# PharmiWeb.com

> > PharmiWeb.com is the comprehensive hub for pharmaceutical, biotech, and life sciences professionals, delivering global news, clinical research insights, career guidance, and industry events.

PharmiWeb.com serves as a central resource for the life sciences community, aggregating pharmaceutical news, clinical trial information, career development resources, and industry conferences. The platform connects professionals across regulatory, research, marketing, and commercial functions with actionable insights and networking opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Clinical trials
- Pharmaceutical industry
- Life sciences
- AI in healthcare
- Drug launch strategy
- Clinical research
- Professional development
- Recruitment and careers
- Healthcare technology
- Industry events
- Patient engagement
- Regulatory affairs
- Biotech partnerships
- UK Biobank
- Pharma news

## Core Resources

- [PharmiWeb.com: The Heart of Life Sciences on the Web](https://www.pharmiweb.com): Global pharma news, biotech, clinical research, jobs, and events hub.
- [Articles Directory](https://www.pharmiweb.com/article): Directory of pharmaceutical articles covering industry topics.
- [Events Directory](https://www.pharmiweb.com/event): Directory of pharma, biotech, and healthcare conferences and training.

## Clinical Trials & Research

- [AI in Clinical Trials: Use Cases, Benefits & What's Next in 2026](https://www.pharmiweb.com/article/ai-in-clinical-trials-use-cases-benefits-what-s-next-in-2026): AI applications in clinical trials for efficiency and data management.
- [Key Clinical Research Roles Every Life Sciences Professional Should Know](https://www.pharmiweb.com/article/key-clinical-research-roles-every-life-sciences-professional-should-know): Guide to clinical research career paths and job descriptions.
- [Panthera Biopartners Joins AMRC to Help Shape Global Clinical Trial Quality](https://www.pharmiweb.com/pwtoday-story/panthera-biopartners-joins-amrc-to-help-shape-global-clinical-trial-quality): Panthera Biopartners joins AMRC to advance multisite clinical research.
- [UK Biobank and Its Growing Importance in the Future of UK Life Sciences](https://www.pharmiweb.com/article/uk-biobank-and-its-growing-importance-in-the-future-of-uk-life-sciences): UK Biobank's role in genomic research and drug discovery.
- [1st International Conference "WE! are the Clinical Research"](https://www.pharmiweb.com/event/1st-international-conference-we-are-the-clinical-research): International clinical research conference by Kozminski University.

- [FDA Approves BRAVECTO QUANTUM from Merck Animal Health](https://www.pharmiweb.com/press-release/2026-03-18/fda-approves-bravecto-quantum-fluralaner-for-extended-release-injectable-suspension-from-merck-an): FDA approval of Merck's BRAVECTO QUANTUM for tick control in dogs.
- [Next Generation Cancer Vaccine Development Summit 2021](https://www.pharmiweb.com/event/next-generation-cancer-vaccine-development-summit-2021): Cancer vaccine summit with Gritstone, BioNTech, and Janssen.
